verdict.rationale: LangSmith's dashboards can group charts by run tag or metadata to split data over application attributes (docs-16, docs-31). Prebuilt dashboards track token usage (docs-14), cost is a tracked alerting metric (docs-12), and threads are inspectable (docs-34). Together these let a developer split usage by custom metadata. However, the docs never explicitly show cost being broken down per user, session, or feature, and a community commenter notes that capturing which user is involved takes extra work (comm-2). missing for 10: explicit documentation of cost/token attribution grouped by metadata, documented per-user and per-session cost breakdowns, independent hands-on corroboration.
